summary: Parallel bays on a parkland lane in the botanic gardens; no homes near.
reasons: Surrounded by park lawn and trees
Cars already park in the bays

best_section.where: Far (north-east) end of the lane bays, away from the junction

drivers.seclusion: Lane runs through gardens with lawn and tree cover on both sides. No dwellings mapped or seen; nearest building is 55 m away and non-residential.
drivers.access_and_room: Paved park lane with marked parallel bays and a few cars parked. Room for a van in the bays.
drivers.traffic: Quiet lane; larger car park with traffic is about 60 m east.
drivers.convention: Public bays used by garden visitors and staff; signs limit stay to 4 hours Mon-Fri 7 am-4 pm only.

flags: Slope about 3% at the best section, 9% max across outline
sun_shade: Tree canopy to the east and north-west; partial shade, open to the south-west.
cannot_judge: Gardens closing times or gate on the lane
